details.summary: Canadian diplomat and Director-General of the United Nations Technical Assistance Administration (TAA) 1950-1958
details.life: Was born 7 July 1898 in Toronto, Ontario, Canada and passed away 27 September 1992 in Victoria, British Columbia. He was the son of Ellis William Keenleyside, insurance underwriter, and Margaret Louise Irvine. On 11 August 1924 he married Katherine Hall Pillsbury. They had three daughters and one son.
